title: 枠付きの壁型枠パネル
description: 建設現場や資材置場向けの一枚型枠パネル。無地の合板調表面、金属の外枠、背面の縦横補強、持ち手、開口した連結金具と留め具を造形。壁・コンクリート・支柱・対向パネルや完成した型枠系統は含みません。単体の立て置き用原点で、支持と配置はシーン側で調整してください。耐圧・緊結・施工安全は未検証。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.986 × 1.800 × 0.190 m、7,132三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A single framed formwork panel for construction and storage-yard scenes, with plain plywood-like facing, metal perimeter, rear grid stiffeners, handgrips, open connection eyes and fasteners. Wall, concrete, braces, opposing panel and a complete formwork system are absent. Its base origin supports upright scene placement; supply visual supports in the host scene. Pressure resistance, fastening and construction safety are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.986 × 1.800 × 0.190 m; 7,132 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
